boundary: The same original nonzero omega^2 Kummer vector has a same-field integral model with actual nonzero roots/constants in both rings of integers. The vector, every finite-prime valuation residue and Selmer membership remain identical. The valuation submodule is the actual Mathlib S=empty Selmer group, with membership equivalent to p-divisibility of all principal-fractional-ideal counts. Conditional on this membership, an actual unique nonzero pth-root fractional ideal (for positive p) and actual ideal-class-group p-torsion witness are constructed. The original Frey vector membership is not supplied. Quotient-level/equivariant class-group maps and exactness, local arithmetic including resonant places and local pth powers at p, arithmetic vanishing and tower iteration remain open; general hno is unfinished.
